# Locked dependency set for `effgen[all]` on Python 3.14.
#
# Plain `pip install effgen[all]` cannot resolve on 3.14. The `vllm` range is
# wide (>=0.2.7,<1.0), and when pip backtracks over an unrelated conflict it
# walks that range backwards until it reaches a release pinned to numba==0.61,
# which predates 3.14 and whose source build refuses to run there. Constraining
# vllm upward instead ends in `resolution-too-deep`. Pinning the whole set is
# what makes the install deterministic:
#
#     pip install -r requirements-all-py314-lock.txt
#     pip install --no-deps effgen
#
# `requirements-all-lock.txt` is the equivalent for 3.11-3.13 and is NOT usable
# here: it pins torch==2.2.1 and vllm==0.4.1, neither of which has a 3.14 wheel.
#
# Regenerate with:
#     uv pip compile --extra all --python-version 3.14 \
#         --output-file requirements-all-py314-lock.txt pyproject.toml
